requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with a >= threshold. The 15-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Energy class D or better is not a reference column and is ignored. The 'Turin' location is a city, not a cadastral code, so comune_code is not set and is left to the Location Agent. The future use as a play space or childcare is not used to filter the current typology.

matched_use_cases: Play space / Baby parking (Centro di custodia oraria)

requirements.description: User requires energy class D or better, so every class from A1 down to D is accepted. Area, capacity, zoning/authorization and proximity to parks are not energy requirements and are not filtered here.
The user prefers a unit near parks. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

output.explanation: Filters commercial-type properties (property_type 'Attività commerciali e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 115, energy_class from A1 to D, green score >= 74, and within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance ascending from that point. No LIMIT applied.
